notes.title: The General Fixes Update
notes.content:
Hey there!

We are aware of an issue related to [b]Coin images not properly loading sometimes in your inventories[/b], we have been trying multiple fixes and[b] the images usually load much better now[/b]. Work is - unfortunately for us - not over yet, and [b]some of your Coins images might still not load properly[/b] on Steam. 

[b]Your Coins are of course still there in all cases[/b], you only need to [b]check back in a little while so the image can try loading again[/b]. This is an issue related to server load. 

[b]We will continue trying to deploy a final solution to this issue[/b]. If you notice any weird behaviour, as in an image loading in place of another, let us know by opening a discussion or leaving a comment providing a screeshot, [b]your feedback is valuable[/b]! ːsteamhappyː


Have a good day boys!ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: The Achievements Rework
notes.content:
Hello there!

[b]After having listened to your feedback[/b], we are reworking a couple things regarding the Achievements: 

First of all, and most important, the (old) [b]Master Coin Collector Achievement now only requires you to gather 500 total Coins[/b], a more fair and [i]achievable[/i] achievement (pun intended) ːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097718/eaa71f3eda04bd9deeb97b515419816860f60a8e.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]

Second, we have also [b]included 4 completely new Achievements[/b], requiring you to [b]collect unique Coins[/b], that is, repeated units won't count for this one! ːsteamthisː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097718/fad56456c9caa116ffff16263c383d5266b4bcc7.png[/img]

[b]This new Achievements are more humble in scope and easier to get[/b], and you should be able to [b]easily get all of them way before having collected 500 Coins[/b] ːsteamhappyː

[hr][/hr]

We have rebranded some of the old Achievements and updated their titles and images, but, most important, [b]now clicking the Coin at least once rewards you with the "I clicked the Coin - Coin"[/b], along with the classic Achievement as well ːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097718/09c85dcb7ab12045371ff132c032ca2f5f81d986.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097718/3b89990b63ab5f0bfdc8c9951772c2c32da82363.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[b]We have listened to your feedback, which we really appreciate, we are sorry if we didn't mange to reach all questions out there[/b], we are working real hard and we really hope it shows! ːsteamthumbsupː


Have a good one!
